title: Mountain Rescue
description:
Airmen assigned to the 347th Rescue Group train to provide personnel recovery worldwide. Check out how one of our HH-60G Pave Hawk pilots worked with rescue personnel from around the world to make the mission happen!

Special thanks to Jake Sloan of Anchorage, Alaska, for footage of the rescue.
